author: Bobby Grayson
description:
README.md says 37 files / 14,697 hand-written lines / ten Gen files / 509 generated lines / 809 theorems / ten worked examples / 73 fixtures (53 ok, 20 error). Batch A left its own replacement text in node 736; this composes on top of it. After batch B the true counts are:

  40 hand-written Lean files under Leanactors/ (not counting Gen/), 15,034 lines
  13 generated files under Leanactors/Gen/, 612 lines
  813 theorems, zero sorry, zero axiom
  13 worked examples (bank, lock, supervisor, task, watchdog, ttl, registry, feed, ringlog, table registry, log store, logs live, radio live)
  79 fixtures: 56 expect-ok, 23 expect-error
  4 of the 13 examples are modules copied unmodified out of real projects (table_registry.ex, log_store.ex, logs_live.ex, radio_live.ex)

Status paragraph, the sentence about copied modules, replace with: "Four are modules that were not written for this repository: elixir/real/table_registry.ex, log_store.ex, logs_live.ex and radio_live.ex are byte-for-byte copies of Loom.Teams.TableRegistry, Ensemble.LogStore, EnsembleWeb.LogsLive and BobsBroadcastWeb.RadioLive, translated with no annotations and no edits (see Untyped mode)."

New row for the example table:

| Radio live | the Play/Stop button agrees with the track | 809, mutant-tested (forgets the second link of the assign chain), also proved |

New rows for the Layout table:

| Leanactors/Examples/RadioLive.lean | BobsBroadcastWeb.RadioLive with no annotations: hand beh, beh_eq_gen, the bounded check that playing is true exactly when now_playing holds a track, the mutant that keeps the old playing, the invariant proved for every state the behaviour produces, and one trace. The property is of the mailbox, not of the running view: handle_event("play", ..) sets playing on its own and that transition is not in the model |

Readiness line: the five projects now report 55 candidate modules, 721 blockers and 4 translatable (loom 1, ensemble 2, bobs_broadcast 1).

Translator header (elixir/to_lean.exs, LiveView assigns paragraph) already carries the chain-fold and nil-test wording; no README change needed for it beyond the counts.
title: README replacement text for round 8 batch B
